note: This knowledge base is synthetic customer-support data for the fictional store LitoShop, created for the COSCUP 2026 MySQL RAG demo. Use it freely.

faqs.question: How do I check my order status?
faqs.answer: Sign in to your LitoShop account, then go to the top-right Member Center → Order lookup to see the status of every order. Statuses are: Processing (order received, not yet shipped), Shipped (tracking number available), Delivered, Completed, and Canceled. If an order still shows Processing more than 24 hours after it was placed, the item may be being prepared. You can also email service@litoshop.example.

faqs.question: Can I cancel an order I placed by mistake?
faqs.answer: While the order is still Processing and has not shipped, you can cancel it yourself from the order detail page in Member Center. The refund goes back to the original payment method. Once the order is Shipped, you cannot cancel it; return the item under the 7-day cooling-off policy after it arrives. Refund timing after cancel: about 3–7 business days for credit cards, about 5–10 business days for ATM transfers.

faqs.question: Can I change the order contents or shipping address?
faqs.answer: You cannot change items or quantities after checkout. Cancel the original order and place a new one. While the order is still Processing, support can help update the shipping address; once it has shipped, the address cannot be changed. If you picked the wrong convenience-store location, contact support before shipment to change it.

faqs.question: My order still has not shipped. What should I do?
faqs.answer: Regular items usually ship within 1–2 business days after checkout. Preorders follow the estimated ship date on the product page. If nothing has shipped after 3 business days, the system sends a delay email. You can also check the order notes in Member Center, or contact live chat (Monday–Friday 09:00–18:00). If we cannot ship because of a stock-out, we will notify you and issue a full refund.

faqs.question: Why was my order canceled automatically?
faqs.answer: Automatic cancels usually happen for one of three reasons: (1) you chose ATM transfer and did not pay within 48 hours; (2) a convenience-store pickup sat unclaimed for 7 days after arrival, was returned, and the system canceled the order; (3) the item was out of stock and could not be restocked within 14 days, so the system canceled and refunded. Canceled orders do not keep promo eligibility; if the campaign is still running, you can place a new order.

faqs.question: Can I merge multiple orders into one shipment?
faqs.answer: Sorry — the system does not support merging orders. Each order has its own shipping fee and shipment. Add everything to the cart and check out once so you pay a single shipping fee. Orders of NT$990 or more also qualify for free shipping.

faqs.question: What delivery options do you have, and how is shipping calculated?
faqs.answer: LitoShop offers three options: home delivery (NT$100), 7-ELEVEN / FamilyMart pickup (NT$60), and convenience-store cash on delivery (NT$60 + NT$15 handling). Orders of NT$990 or more ship free. Home delivery is via Black Cat (Yamato), usually 1–3 business days. Convenience-store pickup usually arrives in 2–4 business days. Offshore islands are post office only, NT$150, about 5–7 business days.

faqs.question: How do I track my package?
faqs.answer: After we ship, you get a shipment email with a tracking number. For home delivery, look up the number on the Black Cat website. For convenience-store pickup, open the order detail page in Member Center and tap Track shipment. When the item arrives at the store we send another SMS and email. If tracking does not update for more than 48 hours, contact support and we will look it up.

faqs.question: How long do I have to pick up a convenience-store order? What if I miss it?
faqs.answer: After the package arrives at the store you have 7 calendar days (including holidays) to pick it up. Unclaimed packages are returned to the depot. The order is then canceled: prepaid orders are refunded to the original method in 7–10 business days; COD orders are simply canceled. If you miss pickup 3 times in a year, convenience-store COD is suspended for 90 days.

faqs.question: Can I choose a delivery time for home delivery?
faqs.answer: At checkout you can pick a preferred window: no preference, before 13:00, or 14:00–18:00. Actual arrival still depends on the courier’s route that day; we cannot guarantee an exact time. If no one is available to sign, the courier leaves a missed-delivery notice and retries the next business day. After two failed attempts the package is returned and the order follows the return process.

faqs.question: Can I order from overseas? Do you ship internationally?
faqs.answer: LitoShop currently ships only within Taiwan, including the offshore islands (Penghu, Kinmen, Matsu). We do not offer international direct shipping. Overseas customers may use a Taiwan freight-forwarding warehouse as the delivery address, but they bear the forwarding risk and any duties. Damage to forwarded packages is not eligible for return or exchange.

faqs.question: Tracking says delivered, but I did not receive the package. What now?
faqs.answer: Please check first: (1) whether the building office, a family member, or a coworker signed for it; (2) the recipient name on the tracking page. If nobody accepted it, contact support within 48 hours of the delivered status. We will open a trace with the courier, which usually takes 3–5 business days. If it is confirmed lost, you can choose a replacement shipment or a full refund.

faqs.question: How do I start a return? How is the 7-day cooling-off period counted?
faqs.answer: Under the Consumer Protection Act you have a 7-day cooling-off period starting the day after delivery (including holidays). To return: Member Center → Order lookup → select the order → Request return, give a reason, and we will schedule a 2–3 business day pickup or give you a convenience-store return code. The cooling-off period is for inspecting the item, not trying it out. Returned items must be unused, with original packaging, accessories, gifts, and invoice.

faqs.question: Which items cannot be returned?
faqs.answer: Except for defects, these items cannot be returned under the government’s reasonable exceptions to the distance-selling withdrawal right: (1) opened underwear, socks, and other personal-hygiene items; (2) opened food or supplements; (3) custom items (engraving, made-to-measure sizes); (4) opened audio/video media or software; (5) newspapers, journals, and magazines. Product pages marked “7-day cooling-off does not apply” say so clearly before purchase.

faqs.question: The item arrived damaged or defective. What should I do?
faqs.answer: We are sorry you received a defective item. Within 7 days of delivery, start a return or exchange in Member Center, choose Product defect, and upload photos (the defect, the outer box, and the inner packaging). After support confirms, we ship a replacement within 3–5 business days of receiving the defective item. LitoShop covers all shipping. If the item is out of stock, we will offer a full refund or an equal-value replacement.

faqs.question: How long does a refund take, and where does the money go?
faqs.answer: Refunds go back to the original payment method: credit-card reversals take about 3–7 business days (your bank’s billing cycle may show it on the next statement); LINE Pay / JkoPay take about 3–5 business days; ATM transfers and convenience-store payments require your own bank account when you request the return and take about 7–10 business days. We email you when the refund is complete. If it is overdue, contact support.

faqs.question: Can I exchange for a different size or color?
faqs.answer: You get one free exchange per order for a different size or color of the same item. Request an exchange in Member Center and specify the new option. After we receive the original item in good condition, the replacement ships in 3–5 business days. If the new option is out of stock, we convert it to a refund. A second exchange costs NT$120 for round-trip shipping. Exchange items must still be unused.

faqs.question: Do I need to send the invoice back with a return?
faqs.answer: If you received a paper invoice, return it with the item. If you requested a company tax ID for expense claims, you must sign a sales-return certificate (support emails it). Cloud invoices (mobile barcode or member carrier) are voided automatically — nothing to do. Missing invoices or incomplete voiding can delay the refund.

faqs.question: What payment methods can I use?
faqs.answer: LitoShop accepts: credit card in full (VISA / MasterCard / JCB); credit-card installments (3, 6, or 12 months; bank fees vary); LINE Pay; JkoPay; Apple Pay; ATM virtual-account transfer (held 48 hours); and convenience-store cash on delivery (extra NT$15 handling). Orders over NT$20,000 can only use credit card or ATM transfer.

faqs.question: Why did my credit-card payment fail?
faqs.answer: Common authorization failures: (1) insufficient limit or an expired card; (2) the bank’s fraud filter blocked the online charge (call the issuer to allow it); (3) the 3-D Secure SMS timed out; (4) wrong card number, expiry, or security code. Try another browser or another card. After 5 failures in a row the system locks payments for 30 minutes.

faqs.question: Where do I find the ATM virtual account, and how long do I have to pay?
faqs.answer: After you choose ATM transfer, the confirmation page and email show a dedicated virtual account (bank code 822, CTBC). Pay within 48 hours or the order is canceled automatically. Reconciliation usually takes about 30 minutes, then the status becomes Paid. Each order has a unique virtual account — do not reuse an old one.

faqs.question: Can I pay in installments? How is interest calculated?
faqs.answer: Orders of NT$3,000 or more can use 3-, 6-, or 12-month credit-card installments. LitoShop does not add an installment fee, but your issuing bank may charge interest or fees — check with the bank. Partner banks include CTBC, Cathay United, E.SUN, Taishin, Fubon, and 7 others (12 total). If you return an installment order, the bank cancels the whole plan and refunds amounts already charged.

faqs.question: I was charged, but the order still shows unpaid. What should I do?
faqs.answer: Online payments sometimes take time to reconcile; status usually updates within 30 minutes. If it still says Awaiting payment after 1 hour, send support the order number, payment method, charge time, and amount (a screenshot helps). We will check within 1 business day. If we confirm a duplicate charge or a charge with no order, you get a full refund.

faqs.question: Can I change the payment method?
faqs.answer: You cannot change the payment method after checkout. If you chose ATM transfer and want a credit card instead, wait 48 hours for the automatic cancel (or cancel it yourself) and place a new order. Paid orders cannot switch payment methods. Make sure the original order is canceled before you reorder so you do not buy twice.

faqs.question: What invoice options do you offer?
faqs.answer: LitoShop issues e-invoices as required by the Ministry of Finance, with four carriers: (1) member carrier (default; stored on your LitoShop account); (2) mobile barcode; (3) citizen digital certificate barcode; (4) company tax ID (triplicate invoice). Invoices are issued within 48 hours of shipment and we email a notice. Winning invoices on the member carrier trigger a notification and we help you claim the prize.

faqs.question: Can I add a company tax ID to the invoice later?
faqs.answer: Before the invoice is issued (that is, before shipment), support can add a uniform invoice number and company name. Once issued, tax rules do not allow changing or reissuing it with a tax ID. For company purchases, fill in the tax ID on the Invoice details field at checkout so it is not missed.

faqs.question: How do I claim a prize if my e-invoice wins?
faqs.answer: If the invoice is on your member carrier and you have set prize-claim details (bank account) in Member Center, winnings are deposited automatically within 20 business days after the draw, with no fee. Mobile-barcode carriers should claim via the Ministry of Finance Uniform Invoice Prize app. For unlinked cloud invoices we email and text you; follow the instructions and set up claim details before the deadline.

faqs.question: How do I register? Can I sign in with a social account?
faqs.answer: Click Register / Sign in in the top-right corner. You can register with email, or sign in with Google, Facebook, or LINE. First-time registration includes NT$100 store credit (valid 30 days; orders of NT$1,000 or more). Social sign-in users should add and verify a mobile number in Member Center so they receive shipping and pickup notices.

faqs.question: How do member tiers work, and what are the benefits?
faqs.answer: Tiers are based on spend in the last 12 months: Regular (from NT$0); Silver (NT$5,000, 1% store-credit cashback); Gold (NT$20,000, 2% cashback + NT$200 birthday credit); Black (NT$60,000, 3% cashback + NT$500 birthday credit + dedicated support + occasional early access to new items). Tiers are recalculated on the 1st of each month; upgrades take effect immediately.

faqs.question: How do I use store credit? Does it expire?
faqs.answer: Apply store credit on the checkout page. It can cover up to 20% of the order total and cannot be used for shipping. Expiry depends on the source: welcome bonus 30 days, purchase cashback 90 days, campaign gifts follow the campaign notice. Unused credit expires and cannot be extended or transferred. On a return, credit used on that order is restored to your account with 30 extra days.

faqs.question: I forgot my password. What should I do?
faqs.answer: On the sign-in page, click Forgot password, enter your registered email, and we send a reset link (valid 30 minutes). If you do not see it, check spam, or confirm you used the same email as when you registered. Google / Facebook / LINE accounts have no separate password — sign in with that provider. After 5 wrong passwords the account locks for 15 minutes.

faqs.question: How do I delete my account, and what happens to my personal data?
faqs.answer: Go to Member Center → Account settings → Delete account, or email support. Before deleting: unused store credit and coupons are void and cannot be restored; open orders must be completed or canceled first. After deletion we delete or de-identify personal data within 30 days under the Personal Data Protection Act, keeping only legally required transaction records (5 years).

faqs.question: How do I claim and use coupons?
faqs.answer: Claim coupons on the Offers page, or via campaign links, email, or the official LINE account. At checkout, pick an eligible coupon in the Coupon field; the discount shows immediately. One coupon per order; you can combine it with store credit. Coupons have a minimum spend and an expiry date. Some sale and campaign items are excluded — the product page will say so.

faqs.question: I entered a discount code and it says invalid. Why?
faqs.answer: Common reasons: (1) a typo (watch case and 0 vs O); (2) you are under the minimum spend; (3) the code expired or hit its use limit; (4) the cart has excluded items (sale or preorder); (5) the code is limited to new members or a specific tier. If you still cannot use it after checking those, send support a screenshot of the error.

faqs.question: The price dropped after I bought it. Can I get the difference back?
faqs.answer: If the price drops before we ship, contact support for a price-match refund as store credit. We do not price-match drops after shipment, flash-sale prices, or the gap after a coupon. Promotions are short-term — check the campaign dates before you buy.

faqs.question: When will an out-of-stock item be restocked? Can I get a notification?
faqs.answer: Out-of-stock pages show Restocking. Click Notify me when back and leave an email; we send a notice when it returns (limited quantity, while supplies last). Regular items usually restock in 2–4 weeks. Imports and seasonal items depend on the supplier and have no fixed date. Items marked Sold out / discontinued will not return.

faqs.question: How do I pick a size? Where is the size chart?
faqs.answer: Every apparel product page has a Specs tab with a detailed size chart (laid-flat measurements in centimeters). Compare against a garment that already fits you. Handmade measurements can be off by 1–2 cm; if you are between sizes, size up. If you are still unsure, tell live chat your height and weight and we will recommend a size. You also get one free exchange.

faqs.question: Will the real color look different from the photos?
faqs.answer: Photos are of the actual product, but lighting and screen settings can make the real color differ slightly. That is normal and not a defect. Color notes on the product page add a text description. For color-sensitive items, check buyer photos in the reviews. Color-difference returns still fall under the 7-day cooling-off period; shipping follows the standard return rules.

faqs.question: I got a suspicious text or call claiming to be LitoShop support. What should I do?
faqs.answer: Please note: LitoShop will never call or text you to operate an ATM, give a full credit-card number, or cancel an installment plan. Hang up and call the 165 anti-fraud hotline to verify. Official notices only come from Member Center, official email (@litoshop.example), and the verified LINE official account (blue badge). Any message that asks you to transfer money is a scam.

faqs.question: I think my account was stolen. What should I do?
faqs.answer: If you see logins or orders that are not yours: (1) change your password (Member Center → Account settings → Change password); (2) check whether the shipping address or linked payment methods were changed; (3) contact support to freeze suspicious orders. Turn on two-step verification (email OTP) and do not reuse this password elsewhere. If we confirm theft, we will cancel and refund transactions that were not yours.

faqs.question: How long is the warranty, and how do I request a repair?
faqs.answer: Appliances and 3C items have a manufacturer warranty (see the product page; usually 1 year). Non-user-caused defects are repaired free during that period. Go to Member Center → Repair service, describe the issue, and support will give you a service-center address or arrange pickup, depending on the brand. Repairs usually take 7–14 business days. Your e-invoice and order record are the warranty proof — no paper card needed.

faqs.question: What are support hours, and how do I reach a person?
faqs.answer: Live text chat: Monday–Friday 09:00–18:00 (closed on weekends and public holidays), via the chat icon at the bottom-right of the site. Off-hours you can leave a message and we reply in order when we are back. Email: service@litoshop.example, usually within 1 business day. We do not offer phone support. During long holidays volume is higher and replies may take up to 2 business days. Thanks for your patience.

faqs.question: I want to complain or share feedback. What channels do you have?
faqs.answer: We take every customer’s feedback seriously. For a complaint: (1) tell live chat and ask to escalate to a support lead (we reply with the outcome within 3 business days); (2) email care@litoshop.example. You can also file a consumer complaint with your city or county consumer service center (hotline 1950). If we adopt your suggestion, we will send NT$100 store credit as a thank-you.
